g.text: mac_array_4x4 — output-stationary MAC array + UVM verification environment
rtl/ · sva/ (bind) · tb_uvm/mac_pkg.sv · regress/ — INT8 × INT8 → INT32 · one tile = K beats (K ≤ 16) then a 4-row drain
mac_txn: rand k_len in [1:16], a_flat[64] / b_flat[64] INT8
K beats: a_col ← a_flat, b_row ← b_flat, in_last @ k=K−1
random idle gaps · random out_ready backpressure
clk · rst_n · handshake · a_col · b_row · c_row
b_row[31:0] · lane j = B[k][j], INT8 · beat k
c_row[127:0] = C[out_row][0..3] — 4 × INT32 lanes · out_valid · out_last · out_row
each PE: acc ← acc + a · b
— bind mac_array_4x4 mac_array_sva u_sva (.*) · sees acc[4][4], en, clr
A1 out_valid → !in_ready · A2 c_row/out_row held while !out_ready · A3 out_row++ per accepted drain beat
A4 out_last ⇔ out_row==3 · A5 acc stable when !en && !clr · A6 en ⇔ in_valid && in_ready
A7 all acc == 0 after last drain beat · A8 input held stable while stalled · A9 reset clears acc
— regress/, no simulator in the loop · python regress\run_regress.py --seeds 20
seed sweep · parses UVM_ERROR & SB PASS
+define BUG1..BUG5 → each must be caught (SB / SVA / golden)
